title: How to Select the Intended Audio Output
overview: This article supports the Select the Intended Audio Output step in the No Sound workflow. It explains how to identify and select the correct playback device in Windows when multiple audio devices are available.
checklist: Save any open work before changing audio settings.
Open the Windows sound output selector from the taskbar or open Settings > System > Sound.
Select the intended speakers, headset, monitor, docking station, or Bluetooth audio device.
If the expected device is not listed, verify that it is connected and powered on.
Play a test sound to verify audio is heard through the selected device.
Record the selected playback device and return to the troubleshooting workflow.
common_indicators: The incorrect playback device is selected.
The expected audio device does not appear.
Audio works immediately after selecting the correct output device.
Windows automatically switches to another playback device.
